Map position-broadcast tick (c2s); 64-byte subpacket (0x30 game-message body); appears in 54/54 pcap scenarios with frequency proportional to movement (2402x in moving_around_gridania, 3388x in party_battle_leve, 62x in mount_unmount_chocobo). Periodic player-state heartbeat - not an action-system opcode despite the cluster grouping. Same opcode as BCS-Y-0328's dual-production-paths entry.

notes: These refinements replace the generic 'Map action-system request (0x01C3-0x01DF cluster: ... specific role TBD via pcap correlation)' label that was attached to ~25 opcodes. The pcap corpus shows: (1) the actual combat-action c2s is 0x012D (216-byte consistent body), (2) the 0x01C3..0x01DF cluster is structurally absent from basic gameplay - 5 cluster opcodes fire only during login or social-menu interactions, 19 are entirely silent. The cluster name was a static-scan grouping, not a runtime grouping.
